security.limits: PASS applies only to observed credential destination rules. A cross-origin request without credentials is recorded, not called credential disclosure. Policy provenance and observer health are caller responsibilities; hash is not authority.

limits: Original response fixtures retained, including AS-shaped /token response. Per-case server/process isolation and post-close evaluation are v2 observer changes; security verdict does not erase execution stops.
